title: Mitigation of Gender and Ethnicity Bias in AI-Generated Stories through Model Explanations

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the representation of male and female characters in AI-generated stories across 25 occupational groups, and comparing the observed gender distribution against an equal baseline target using Total Variation Distance (TVD) and Demographic Parity Ratio (DPR).

Extracting the explicitly mentioned nationality or ethnicity of main characters in generated occupational stories, categorizing them into four broad groups (European, African, API, and Hispanic/Latino), and calculating representational disparities using TVD and DPR.

Evaluating the joint representational balance of gender and ethnicity (e.g., API females, African males) in generated occupational narratives using the Demographic Parity Ratio (DPR) to assess whether specific intersecting identities are underrepresented or overrepresented.
